pictures.name: hill_track_in_morning
pictures.scene: a stony track climbing a green hillside in early light, the nearest stones and grass lit warm and clear, the long slope above it rising into a soft pale haze with nothing else standing on it at all

pictures.name: two_streams_joining
pictures.scene: two small clear streams running together into one channel over smooth rock, the joined water lit bright and warm at the bottom of the frame, the shaded bank above them dark and green and very quiet

pictures.name: two_olive_trees_grown_together
pictures.scene: two old olive trees standing so close that their trunks and branches have grown into one another, their bark lit warm and low, the joined canopy above them broad and dark against a wide pale sky

pictures.name: oil_poured_from_a_flask
pictures.scene: a stone flask tipped over a shallow bowl with a thin bright thread of oil falling from its lip, the oil and the rim of the bowl lit warm and gold low in the frame, the dark table above them plain and still

pictures.name: oil_over_the_stone_rim
pictures.scene: oil running slowly over the carved rim of a deep stone basin and gathering in a bright bead beneath it, the wet stone lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the basin above it dim and smooth and plain

pictures.name: dew_on_grass
pictures.scene: a close bank of meadow grass heavy with dew at first light, every blade beaded and shining warm along the bottom of the frame, the field beyond it soft and grey and fading away into an unbroken mist

pictures.name: spring_at_the_mountain_foot
pictures.scene: a clear spring welling up out of the rock at the foot of a great mountain, the moving water lit warm and bright low in the frame, the vast slope above it quiet and blue and holding no detail at all

pictures.name: oil_soaking_the_cloth
pictures.scene: a heavy woollen collar laid open on a bench with oil soaking slowly outward through the weave, the dark wet spread lit warm from one side at the bottom of the frame, the room above it brown and still

pictures.name: snow_peak_above_green_slopes
pictures.scene: a high snow covered peak standing far above long green slopes, the near pasture lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the white summit and the sky around it pale and cool and wide open

pictures.name: green_valley_full_of_water
pictures.scene: a wide valley floor thick with green growth and threaded with bright standing water, the nearest reeds and pools lit warm at the bottom of the frame, the far hills above them soft and blue and calm

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
Behold, how good and pleasant it is
when brothers live together in harmony!
It is like fine oil on the head,
over the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Hermon
falling on the mountains of Zion.
For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing
